implement SLA cronjob with fail-fast config and persistent blocking alerts - **Fail-Fast Configuration**: Enforce explicit scheduling configurations (`cron`, `zone`, `warning-hours`, `critical-hours`) in `application.yml` by removing `@Value` defaults, preventing silent fallback failures. - **Timezone Strictness**: Bind `zone="Asia/Ho_Chi_Minh"` directly to `@Scheduled` to neutralize cloud server UTC discrepancies. - **Escalation Mechanism**: Build a multi-tier alert system in `SupplierReturnScheduler` using clean, semantic time boundaries: - Warning Alert: Triggers internal reminders after a configurable threshold. - Critical Alert: Triggers executive escalations after a strict threshold. - **Persistent Blocking UI**: Expose `GET /sla/critical-alerts` API to feed the frontend with critically overdue records, enforcing mandatory administrative resolution (Approve/Reject) to unblock the system. - **Architecture Reusability**: Seamlessly integrate the SLA features by fully reusing existing DTOs (`SupplierReturnResponse`), mappers, and domain exceptions, strictly adhering to the Open-Closed Principle (OCP).
